name: Short Cut Mango Shrimp Curry with Mixed Veggies & Basmati Rice

ingredients.name: raw shrimp, peeled & deveined, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Place simmer sauce, veggies, mango, salt, and pepper in a large skillet, then stir to combine the curry. Bring curry to a boil over high heat, stirring occasionally. Once boiling, reduce heat and simmer until veggies and mango are just tender, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (15 oz) jar Indian mango curry sauce
2 cups frozen mixed vegetables
1 cup frozen mango
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 oz raw shrimp, peeled & deveined, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Add shrimp to the curry and stir to combine; return to a simmer and continue to cook until shrimp are cooked through, 4-5 minutes more. Remove from heat.

Meanwhile, squeeze pouches to separate rice, then tear a two-inch opening at the top of each to vent. Place both packages in the microwave and heat on high until warmed through, 2-2 1/2 minutes. Carefully remove from microwave and set aside to cool slightly.
To serve, divide rice and curry between bowls. Enjoy!
